d: Gold Rush showcases the raw physical and mechanical battle required to carve open the frozen wilderness in search of life-changing fortunes. Focusing on the toughest excavation challenges in the Klondike, this compilation captures crews tearing through rock-solid permafrost and digging deep into hazardous ground conditions. From massive bulldozers straining against impenetrable frost to delicate bedrock cleanups that make or break a season's goal, every dig tests both crew endurance and machine reliability. Experience the intense pressure, high-stakes decisions, and hard-earned triumphs…
